name: 2-pyrrolidone
description: 2-Pyrrolidone (CAS 616-45-5 ) is a cyclic lactam used across industrial and specialty chemical markets as a solvent, monomer, and functional additive. It serves as a direct precursor to polyvinylpyrrolidone and as an intermediate in the synthesis of other N-substituted pyrrolidones. Buyers source it primarily for polymer production, ink formulation, and personal care applications. In inkjet and printing ink systems, it functions as a co-solvent and humectant that controls drying rate and prevents nozzle clogging in aqueous formulations. It acts as a key monomer and building block in the manufacture of PVP and related polymers used in pharmaceutical binders, adhesives, and coatings. Personal care formulators incorporate it as a humectant and penetration enhancer in skin and hair care products. In electronics manufacturing, it is used as a processing solvent for polymer films and specialty coatings where low residue and compatibility with sensitive substrates matter. This versatility makes it a staple in high-performance chemical manufacturing. 2-Pyrrolidone is supplied as a colorless to pale yellow liquid in drum and IBC quantities. Technical grade and high-purity grades are the standard commercial offerings, with pharmaceutical-grade material available to meet USP and Ph. Eur. specifications. Packaging options typically range from small containers for specialty applications to bulk tanker supply for polymer production.
